actions.name: Canter
actions.desc: The unicorn moves up to half is speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Healing Touch
actions.desc: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn. The target magically regains 11 (2d8+2) HP and is freed from all curses, diseases, and poisons afflicting it.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Horn
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Horn Bolt
actions.desc: _Ranged Spell Attack:_ +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 13 (3d6+3) radiant damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Horn attack, or it makes two Horn Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Radiant Stomp
actions.desc: The unicorn raises its hooves glowing with golden light and brings them down with a reverberating stomp. Each hostile creature within 10 feet of the unicorn must make a DC 14 STR save. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) radiant damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

actions.name: Radiant Stomp (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.desc: The unicorn raises its hooves glowing with golden light and brings them down with a reverberating stomp. Each hostile creature within 10 feet of the unicorn must make a DC 14 STR save. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) radiant damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

actions.name: Shimmering Shield
actions.desc: When a creature the unicorn can see within 30 feet of it, including the unicorn, is attacked, the unicorn can surround it with a shimmering shield of radiant light. The target adds 3 to its AC against the attack.

actions.name: Unicorn Magic
actions.desc: The unicorn can cast the dancing lights and druidcraft cantrips at will, requiring no material components and using WIS as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Celestial Resilience
traits.desc: The unicorn is resistant to radiant damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The unicorn has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Sense the Unnatural
traits.desc: The unicorn can pinpoint the location of Aberrations and Undead within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.desc: The unicorn can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Woodland Walk
traits.desc: Difficult terrain composed of nonmagical plants doesn't cost the unicorn extra movement. In addition, the unicorn can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.
